name: Judas
source:
Judas is one of the original 12 disciples. Judas caused quite the stir when he betrayed Jesus for the low price of thirty pieces of silver. Or at least, that's how the story went. The details are quite fuzzy now!

Now, Judas serves Lucifer as his chief attendant and hype man. Judas is Hell's event coordinator, and he loves his job. Events such as Slam Poetry with Abaddon, Monday Luau, and Lilith's Karaoke have made him Hell's fan favorite.

Judas spends a good amount of his free time creating items that can transfer between the physical planes and spiritual planes. He has so many breakthroughs, and he just loves to talk about them!

Judas is always down for a good time, and you should be too!
